description: Move the current time to the previous, next, first or last keyframe (the keyframe navigator arrows, J and K): of one property, or of every animated property of the layers (the selected layers by default)

comp.description: Which composition. Give its item id (from list_items) or name; omit for the active composition

layers.description: Which layers. Give indexes (1-based, from list_layers), names, or selected: true. Default the selected layers

property.description: A property: a shortcut (anchor_point, position, scale, rotation, opacity, x_rotation, y_rotation, orientation, source_text, time_remap, audio_levels) or a path of match names or display names from the layer, e.g. ["ADBE Effect Parade", "Gaussian Blur", "Blurriness"]. Omit for every animated property

name: go_to_keyframe
title: Go To Keyframe
